Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Time, the calendar & feasts

New Year’s Day noun

also New Year, happy New Year

classical

M-O s.v. New Year

Kalendae Jānuāriae

Other words

  • annus novus — the new year

    also used · classical · Sen. Ep. 83.5: annō novō; M-O s.v. New Year

Examples

  • quī Kalendīs Jānuāriīs eurīpum salūtābam, quī annō novō quemadmodum legere, scrībere, dīcere aliquid, sīc auspicābar in Virginem dēsilīre

    I, who used to greet the canal on New Year’s Day, and began each new year with a plunge into the Aqua Virgo, as I began it with reading, writing and saying somethingSen. Ep. 83.5

  • Novum Annum laetum tibi exoptō.

    I wish you a happy New Year.Traupman 409

See also New Year’s Eve, New Year’s present, January, the Kalends.
